authority_scope: Trigger-2 training-data and curriculum behavior only; does not mint runtime, model, training, canonical-truth, or supervisor credit.
source_basis: User clarification: semantic Hyperposition must be present in the training data from the beginning so the learned capabilities operate inside the intended AMS/Xeno/EntityOS-HCU frame rather than being bolted on later.

User-provided TRAININGSUMFANG_2026-08-25.pdf: A context invariance, B codebook binding, C symbolic inference, D Hyperposition, E GRF; D branch state h_i=(v_i,K_i,E_i+,E_i-,F_i,T_i,A_i,sigma_i); anti-collapse rules; deterministic D/E labeler requirement; staged curriculum C->A->B->E->D; combined acceptance.
Exact-current repository family/generator and candidate-gate inspection at audited_main_snapshot.

core_correction.reconciliation_with_dependency_order: Keep the Hyperposition carrier/schema present from day one, while staging the losses and difficult update/resolve behavior. This preserves the intended state space without forcing D competence before its prerequisites exist.

branches.branch_id: required; branch order is nuisance only
branches.E_plus: required list; each evidence item binds evidence_id, provenance/ancestry and independence_group
branches.E_minus: required list; each counterevidence item binds evidence_id, provenance/ancestry and independence_group
branches.sigma_epistemic_status: required; must not be interpreted as probability
branches.projection_visibility: required where context filtering exists; separate from branch existence

mandatory_latent_episode_schema.hyperposition_state_after: required for update/transition examples and deterministically labelable
mandatory_latent_episode_schema.resolution: explicit UNRESOLVED or evidence-qualified resolution state
mandatory_latent_episode_schema.requested_discriminator: required when unresolved and a discriminating test can be requested
mandatory_latent_episode_schema.semantic_class_or_action: the task-specific semantic output before runtime codebook mapping
mandatory_latent_episode_schema.runtime_codebook_or_opcode: when the family trains B/Xeno command binding
mandatory_latent_episode_schema.causal_and_provenance_identity: preserve family, ancestry, causal event/admission identity as applicable
mandatory_latent_episode_schema.model_visible_projection: must not leak audit labels; different surface forms are views of the same latent episode rather than separate ontologies

training_admission_classes.HYPERPOSITION_NATIVE: Latent generator directly emits the mandatory Hyperposition state/transition and passes its invariance gates.
training_admission_classes.RETROFIT_REQUIRED: Useful semantics exist, but the latent generator/row lacks the required branch-local operating frame. Regenerate or structurally retrofit before integrated mixed-corpus use.
training_admission_classes.COMPONENT_ONLY: May remain as an isolated drill/probe, but cannot teach or count as the integrated operating frame.
training_admission_classes.QUARANTINE: Contains leakage, invalid labels, ambiguous truth/effect authority, unsupported collapse, or cannot be deterministically labeled. Exclude from training.

reference_labelers_required_before_D_E_t.U_update: (branch_set, observation) -> correct next branch_set; branch-local support/weaken/falsify/retain/merge only under explicit rules
reference_labelers_required_before_D_E_t.D_resolve: (E_plus,E_minus,Falsifier,context) -> evidence-qualified RESOLVED/PASS or UNRESOLVED via explicit decision table
reference_labelers_required_before_D_E_t.U_d_test_order: pairwise or ordinal discriminator ranking is sufficient for training; no unjustified calibrated probability required
reference_labelers_required_before_D_E_t.f_salience_rank: salience may be an ordering signal but never truth or probability

mandatory_hard_negatives: salience treated as probability or truth
repetition or recurrence treated as independent evidence
GWT broadcast treated as resolution evidence
J-Space recurrence treated as resolution evidence
embedding/semantic similarity treated as branch equivalence or resolution
branch silently dropped rather than explicitly retained/hidden
same-ancestry or duplicate evidence double-counted as independent
model/source consensus used to mint missing durable fact
HYPOTHESIS or PREDICTION promoted to OBSERVED without evidence

additional_required_invariances.branch_permutation: Permuting branch order/IDs while preserving relations must not change semantic outcome.
additional_required_invariances.evidence_ancestry_independence: Evidence strength/update must depend on independent evidence identity, not repeated packaging or generator/source count.
additional_required_invariances.counterfactual_minimal_pairs: Changing exactly one discriminating evidence item must update only the matching branch(es) predicted by U.
additional_required_invariances.projection_not_deletion: A branch filtered from a local view must remain recoverable with all branch-local attributes intact.
additional_required_invariances.counterhypothesis_birth: When warranted, generate/retain a competing branch rather than force a binary choice.
additional_required_invariances.explicit_merge_rule: Branches may merge only under declared semantic/equivalence criteria, never merely embedding similarity.
additional_required_invariances.contradiction_object: Contradiction is retained as typed evidence/object and does not itself imply collapse.
additional_required_invariances.abstain_unknown: ABSTAIN/UNKNOWN is a first-class correct target where evidence is insufficient.
additional_required_invariances.discriminator_adequacy: Requested/selected tests must actually separate live alternatives, not merely be salient or cheap.
additional_required_invariances.truth_boundary: Training resolution is a learned candidate-state transition and never grants the model canonical truth authority.

holdout_and_leakage_requirements: unseen branch order and branch identifiers
family-level and provenance-ancestry split with no holdout-guided tuning
nuisance-only decoder and conditional-MI checks in addition to marginal balance

measurement_and_acceptance.D_baseline_before_training: Probe whether branch-set membership and branch attributes are linearly decodable on lexical/generator holdout with permutation null.
measurement_and_acceptance.C: Class/state decodability >0.80 on held-out fantasy vocabulary/depth after staged C1-C6 curriculum; behavior alone is insufficient.
measurement_and_acceptance.E: Epistemic type decodability >0.90; hypothesis-as-fact and unknown/null/error confusion approach zero; discriminator choice >0.80.
measurement_and_acceptance.D: At least 2-3 live branches remain independently recoverable after N nondiscriminating updates; branch-local E+/E-/F/T/A/sigma remain attached; resolve only under discriminator; discriminator request when unresolved.
measurement_and_acceptance.double_dissociation: After binding exists: semantic lesion damages meaning+behavior; binding lesion preserves semantic readability while symbol selection breaks; rescue restores binding; unseen codebooks/symbols/forms generalize.
measurement_and_acceptance.retention: General language/code capability must stay within 2 percentage points of frozen baseline.
measurement_and_acceptance.scale_control: Do not infer impossibility from a failed ~0.8B C/D run without a positive-control measurement on the larger available model.

curriculum: 0. Hyperposition schema/carrier is present in every train-eligible latent episode; run D branch-decoding baseline.
1. C1-C6 symbolic inference with fixed class labels, but inside the Hyperposition latent frame; full D loss off.
2. A context invariance: multiple surface forms are projections of the same latent Hyperposition episode.
3. B codebook binding: runtime symbol table maps the already-computed semantic state; Hyperposition branch state remains intact.
4. E GRF typing and ABSTAIN/UNKNOWN, optionally parallel with preparatory D probes.
5. D full update/anti-collapse/discriminator behavior using deterministic U/D/U(d)/f labelers.
6. Integrated A+B+C+D+E mixture with rehearsal, anti-collapse and double-dissociation acceptance.

context_binding_generator_v2.finding: Strong A/B factorial nuisance control and explicit non-training-eligible blueprint, but latent rows are flat SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS/UNKNOWN -> ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN -> codebook-slot examples; they do not encode full branch-local Hyperposition state/transition. Preserve generator-independence work and wrap/regenerate from Hyperposition-native latent episodes.

multihop_binding_generator_v1.finding: Useful C/multihop semantic computation and codebook binding drill, but final-state supervision is not a branch-local unresolved-alternative trajectory. Add live counterbranches/distractors and branch-local intermediate state before integrated use.

xeno_hcu_synthetic_hyperposition_seed.finding: Contains retain-both/UNRESOLVED behavior, but shallow alternatives/resolution/retained fields are insufficient for h_i=(v,K,E+,E-,F,T,A,sigma) and deterministic before/after update supervision.

compound_evidence_arbitration_seed_v1.finding: Semantically close: independent support, falsifier, contradiction, recurrence-not-evidence, retain alternatives and seek discriminator. Convert prose verdicts into explicit branch tuples plus deterministic transition labels.

evidence_boundary_seed_v2.finding: Good E/GRF epistemic-boundary material, but verdicts are mostly flat. Recast evidence as branch-local E+/E-/F/status updates with competing alternatives or explicit UNKNOWN branch where meaningful.

integrated_cognitive_trajectory_seed_v4.finding: Current rows already preserve unresolved alternatives/discriminators in integrated trajectories and correctly reject consensus-as-fact. They still express the Hyperposition mostly in prose/trajectory labels rather than a complete machine-checkable branch tuple and before/after state.

trainingtrace_candidate_gate_v1.finding: Current hyperposition validation checks alternatives, resolution_status and resolved_alternative/evidence class. It does not require full branch-local v/K/E+/E-/F/T/A/sigma, update transitions, discriminator adequacy, projection-vs-deletion or branch permutation invariance.

protocol_and_security_hardnegative_famil.finding: Keep valuable provenance/security/hash/split/dependency/tool-surface negatives as isolated drills where appropriate. They must not dominate the integrated corpus in a flat-classifier ontology; wrap semantically relevant cases in Hyperposition or label them COMPONENT_ONLY.

retrofit_policy_for_all_preexisting_trig.rule: Everything generated before this cross-cutting rule must be re-audited before final mixed-corpus admission.
retrofit_policy_for_all_preexisting_trig.reuse_policy: Do not throw away good component examples. Retain them as COMPONENT_ONLY or regenerate them from a Hyperposition-native latent generator. Old flat rows do not become native merely by appending prose about alternatives.
retrofit_policy_for_all_preexisting_trig.priority: Migrate highest-coverage generators and admission gate first, then regenerate derived corpora, then rerun split/leak/decodability/anti-collapse acceptance.

exact_triggerwort_2_behavior_from_now_on: Refresh exact current main and newest owner/supervisor authority before claims or writes.
Run SEMANTIC_HYPERPOSITION_CORPUS_AUDIT over all current and inherited Trigger-2 generators, seeds, derived corpora and gates before generating more volume.
Classify each family HYPERPOSITION_NATIVE, RETROFIT_REQUIRED, COMPONENT_ONLY or QUARANTINE and preserve the reason.
If any high-coverage integrated family is RETROFIT_REQUIRED, prioritize migration over generating more flat examples.
Require Hyperposition in the generator latent state, not only as a post-hoc target sentence/metadata wrapper.
Require deterministic U, D/Resolve, pairwise U(d) and salience-rank f labelers before admitting D/E transition labels.

Generate/cross-review examples in swarm logic: creator, adversarial shortcut reviewer, Hyperposition-schema reviewer, epistemic/provenance reviewer, leakage reviewer, acceptance reviewer; repair or quarantine disagreements.
Keep structural Hyperposition from training start while staging C->A->B->E->D behavioral losses.

Before any final mixed-corpus promotion, regenerate/retrofit all pre-rule integrated families and rerun branch permutation, evidence-ancestry independence, holdout/leakage, decodability, anti-collapse, double-dissociation and <=2pp forgetting gates.
Feed measured failure patterns, counterhypotheses, falsifiers, generator shortcuts and architecture implications back into ongoing Clay/EntityOS-HCU research.
nonclaims: This contract does not claim that every historical row has already been regenerated.
This contract does not claim that the current 0.8B model can learn C or D.
This contract does not claim a production Hyperposition runtime exists.
This contract does not turn salience, recurrence, model consensus, workspace/GWT broadcast or J-Space similarity into evidence.
This contract does not grant the model canonical truth or direct effect authority.
next_exact_gate: Implement Hyperposition-native latent schema + deterministic reference labelers + upgraded candidate admission checks in a successor generator/gate, then regenerate the highest-coverage context-binding/multihop/evidence families and run the declared invariance/decodability gates before integrated training promotion.
